title: Sr Database Administrator
description:
Job Title: Senior SQL Database Administrator 
 Experience: 10-12 Years 
 Location: Hyderabad (Office / Rotational) 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are looking for a Senior SQL Database Administrator with 10-12 years of experience to lead the design, optimization, and automation of enterprise-scale database systems. This role requires deep expertise in performance tuning, large database management (10TB+), and building automation frameworks that integrate on-premises and AWS environments. The ideal candidate will adopt an infrastructure as code mindset and drive scalable, high-performance data solutions. Key Responsibilities Database Administration & Maintenance Manage, monitor , and maintain SQL Server databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security. Design and support complex replication topologies to maintain data consistency across distributed environments. Perform regular health checks, system audits, and capacity planning. Performance Tuning & Optimization Conduct advanced performance tuning and bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, and storage layers ( NVMe /EBS) for very large databases (VLDBs). Perform wait state analysis and optimize storage I/O performance. High Availability & Disaster Recovery Design, implement, and manage SQL Server Always On Availability Groups. Troubleshoot high-latency transactional replication issues in high-throughput systems. Establish and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies. Automation & Scripting Develop self-service automation solutions for development teams (e.g., automated database refreshes, schema validation). Build and maintain cross-platform automation frameworks using PowerShell, Python, or Ansible. Implement automated compliance checks and health monitoring for large-scale environments. Database Migration & Upgrades Architect and execute migration strategies for large databases (10TB+) from on premises to AWS (EC2/RDS) with minimal downtime. Utilize tools and techniques such as Log Shipping, Mirroring, and AWS DMS. Leverage Delphix for data virtualization and masking to streamline non-production data provisioning. Cloud & Infrastructure Deploy and manage SQL Server databases in AWS environments, including RDS and EC2. Ensure adherence to cloud best practices for scalability, security, and cost optimization. Monitoring & Troubleshooting Proactively monitor database performance and resolve incidents. Use monitoring tools such as Foglight , DataDog , CloudWatch, and Redgate. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions. Collaboration Collaborate with application development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams. Provide database design guidance and support development initiatives. Required Skills & Qualifications 10-12 years of experience as a SQL Server DBA. Proven experience managing large-scale databases (10TB+). Strong expertise in: SQL Server performance tuning (execution plans, indexing, query optimization) Always On Availability Groups SQL Server Replication Backup and recovery strategies Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting for automation. Experience with Delphix (data virtualization and masking). Strong knowledge of AWS database services. Experience in database migrations and upgrades. Solid understanding of database security and compliance practices. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Good to Have Skills Experience with CommVault for backup and recovery. Working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases. Exposure to Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Managed Instances). Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines. Soft Skills Ability to translate complex technical database challenges into actionable business insights for stakeholders and provide technical mentorship to junior team members. Proven ability to maintain composure and lead technical resolution during high-pressure production outages and complex multi-wave cloud migrations. A strategic mindset focused on Automation First - proactively identifying manual bottlenecks and architecting long-term scalable solutions rather than quick fixes.

title: Database Admin MongoDB
description:
Database Admin MongoDB Location: Hyderabad Experience: 5-8 years Immediate Joiners Shift: Rotational 
 We are looking for Mongo DBA along with Oracle and PostgreSQL knowledge, to be part of our Database Operations teamp that works 24x7x365 to ensure our critical systems are up and serving our customers round the clock. The candidate should have a strong mindset to look at the bigger picture, think over and beyond, suggest steps to gain greater control over complex systems. In this role, The MongoDB DBA will be responsible for the administration, performance, and security of our MongoDB environments. This role ensures database reliability, scalability, and compliance while supporting application teams with schema design, query optimization, and operational excellence. The DBA will play a key role in maintaining high availability and disaster recovery readiness across mission-critical systems. Job Qualifications: Database Administration : Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain MongoDB database environments. Administer MongoDB clusters across development, test, staging, and production environments. Manage MongoDB Replica Sets and highly available database architectures. Configure and manage MongoDB Sharded Clusters for large-scale workloads. Manage database users, roles, authentication, authorization, and access controls. Perform database health checks and proactively identify operational risks. Manage database configuration, storage, capacity, and lifecycle activities. Maintain database standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Design and support highly available MongoDB architectures. Configure and administer Replica Sets across multiple Availability Zones/data centers. Monitor replication health, replication lag, elections, rollbacks, and oplog utilization. Design and maintain MongoDB disaster recovery solutions. Define and implement appropriate RPO and RTO requirements. Conduct regular failover, recovery, and disaster recovery exercises. Troubleshoot replication failures and node synchronization issues. Ensure production environments meet agreed availability and resilience SLAs. Performance Optimization : Monitor query performance, tune indexes, and optimize schema design for efficiency. High Availability & DR : Implement backup strategies, disaster recovery plans, and ensure RTO/RPO compliance. Design and implement enterprise MongoDB backup strategies and manage logical, physical, and snapshot-based backup solutions as appropriate. Security Management : Manage authentication, authorization, encryption, and compliance with data security standards. Monitoring & Automation : Use tools like Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, or third-party monitoring solutions to automate alerts and reporting. Capacity Planning : Forecast storage, compute, and scaling needs to support business growth. Incident Management : Troubleshoot database issues, resolve outages, and provide root cause analysis. Index and Schema Management: Design indexes based on application query patterns and workload characteristics. Identify unused, redundant, or inefficient indexes. Review index utilization and storage overhead. Optimize MongoDB document models and schema designs in collaboration with application teams. Analyze collection and index growth. MongoDB Integrity and Data Reliability: Implement MongoDB database integrity and health-check processes.Use collection validation and MongoDB diagnostic capabilities where appropriate. Monitor WiredTiger storage engine health and database logs. Investigate corruption, checksum, storage, and I/O-related errors. Experience in database upgrade/migrate, patching, backup recovery of large databases. Plan and implement major upgrades, ensuring system integrity and monitoring Analyze, solve, and prepare RCA for production outages. Provide cost/time estimates, capacity planning of database environments. Institute process for continuous improvement, perform other related duties as assigned. Assist on critical production issues, identify root cause and provide mitigation plan. Work with various product/application teams across the company Understand the product architecture and prepare Service Improvement for efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum years of rich experience on multiple database technologies primarily MongoDB, Oracle and Postgres. Strong knowledge of replication, sharding, indexing, and schema design . Familiarity with monitoring tools (New Relic, CloudWatch, Ops Manager). Experience in implementing and managing database clustering and HA/DR systems. o Ability to diagnose problems and triage/resolve issues across various tiers (application, network, database, server, or storage tiers). Experience in database upgrade/migrate, patching, backup recovery of large databases. Ability to develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts and Strong Automation mindset/experience. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, Positive attitude and strong commitment to delivering quality work, Ability to multitask under pressure, prioritize work based on criticality. Should be flexible and open to work in 24x7 environment in any shifts, willing to work on holidays, over weekends as per the demand from Project. Key Responsibilities Collaborative partner: Works autonomously and with other engineers and customers to support and maintain monitoring products by ensuring availability of all tools and completing customer requests on-time with quality. Addresses technical challenges and ensures quality through collaborative design and development. Forward Thinker: Applies proactive mindset to continually look for ways to improve performance, quality and efficiency. Designs, develops, analyzes, and automates report on critical metrics that provide insights into overall health ensuring the notifications are delivered effectively and efficiently to meet the enterprise availability, stability and reliability goals. Problem Solver: Configures, administers and manages core monitoring infrastructure to support the tools (custom or vended), including new releases, upgrades, patch, and vulnerability management. Champions on core observability principles delivery solutions based on effective Application Performance Monitoring, Infrastructure or Platform Monitoring, Real User Monitoring, Synthetics Monitoring, Mobile Monitoring, Network Monitoring and SaaS / Cloud Monitoring. Automation and Governance: Administers IT Runbook system to ensure all processes are properly documented and adhered to published standards. Enforces compliance requirements for documentation’s data integrity, accuracy, and completeness. Helps automate, streamline or rectify workflows required for onboarding or instrumentation of applications, infrastructure, databases, and other middleware tiers to monitoring products. Site Reliability Mindset: Participates in root cause analysis exercise and builds post-mortem documents of the critical problems. Identifies opportunities, design and build automated tools that help reduce efforts and saves cost on repeatable tasks for cross-platform products.

Key Skills: Installation,Configuration,DBMS,Administration,MongoDB

title: Database Administrator
description:
We are looking for a Database Administrator (DBA) with 35 years of experience in managing PostgreSQL databases. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Google Cloud Alloy DB, database administration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security, and high availability. The role involves working closely with software development, analytics, and DevOps teams to ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing database environments. 
 About Us 
Join Comfort Click, a premier e-commerce multinational specializing in branded nutraceuticals, vitamins, minerals, and healthcare products for humans and pets. Since our inception in 2005, we have rapidly expanded across Europe and continue to strengthen our footprint globally.
In 2025, Comfort Click became a proud part of Zydus Wellness Ltd., one of India’s most respected and publicly listed healthcare and wellness companies. Backed by the legacy, trust, and innovation of Zydus, we are now entering an exciting new phase of growth — combining our strong e-commerce expertise with the stability and scale of a global healthcare leader.
Our UK headquarters, along with our dynamic Indian offices in Hyderabad and Vadodara, are at the forefront of continuous innovation, strongly focused on nurturing in-house talent. We cultivate a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, where decision-making is swift, ideas are valued, and your contributions make a visible impact. At the same time, being part of Zydus Wellness provides the credibility, career stability, and opportunities that come with a world-renowned healthcare group.
Be part of Comfort Click’s exhilarating growth story within the Zydus family, where your career is empowered by both speed and scale. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Install, configure, administer, and maintain PostgreSQL databases. Manage and support Google Cloud AlloyDB environments. Monitor database performance and proactively identify bottlenecks. Optimize SQL queries, indexes, and database configurations for improved performance. Perform regular database health checks and capacity planning. Configure and monitor automated backups and recovery procedures. Implement disaster recovery strategies and perform periodic recovery testing. Manage database users, roles, permissions, and security policies. Ensure database availability, reliability, and data integrity. Troubleshoot production database issues and provide timely resolutions. Support database migrations, upgrades, and patch management. Collaborate with application developers to design efficient database structures. Create and maintain database documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks. Monitor storage utilization, replication, and database growth. Participate in production deployments and release activities. 
 Qualification 
 3–5 years of hands-on experience administering PostgreSQL databases. Good understanding of database architecture and relational database concepts. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), preferably AlloyDB. Strong knowledge of SQL and query optimization. Experience with backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of PostgreSQL extensions and performance tuning. Familiarity with Linux system administration. Understanding of database security, access management, and auditing. Experience using monitoring tools such as pg Admin, Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring. Ability to troubleshoot database performance and operational issues. Good to Have: 
 Experience with Cloud SQL or other managed PostgreSQL services. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of ETL workflows and data warehousing concepts. Exposure to Big Query or other cloud analytics platforms. Google Cloud certification is an added advantage. Benefits 
 Market-leading pay rates. Performance-based incentives. 95% of management promoted from within. Service recognition awards. Dynamic, motivated international team. Regular performance recognition awards. Fantastic social events. Comfort Click is a proud equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.
We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. If you are an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting us at recruitment@comfortclick.co.uk.
